items.title: 云山图卷 SAMC GALLERY
items.description: Pink's third solo exhibition. Location: SAMC Gallery, Trinity Western University, Langley, BC, Canada. Time: March 16 - 23, 2026. Artist Talk & Opening Reception: 8:15 - 9:00 pm, March 19, 2026.
items.author: Letong Chen

items.title: 云山图卷 THE SCROLL OF CLOUD & MOUNTAIN
items.description: This exhibition breaks the boundary between painting and installation through a contemporary fusion of both eastern and western visual theories and traditions, reintroducing the space as a field where the subject and viewers coexist with and reconstruct each other.
items.author: Letong Chen
